tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle comparing the current 32-hour-per-week Pocket Lantern Home Care aide schedule at $38 per hour with a higher-coverage scenario, showing when the $142,000 held at Teacup Comet Bank would require increased withdrawals from the $615,000 Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle that keeps gifts, wages, and shared household costs separate, given Lila Cloudpuddle's reduced clinic hours for weekday transportation and medication supervision.
tickets.evidence: Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Obtain long-term care claim file materials
tickets.text: Obtain the full policy contract, claim packet, and elimination-period instructions from Amber Teapot Life Insurance for Martin Cloudpuddle's long-term care claim, since Helena Cloudpuddle has only the premium notice referencing a 90-day elimination period and $210 daily benefit limit.
tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile Pocket Lantern Home Care aide hours
tickets.text: Reconcile the first service week's billed aide hours in Pocket Lantern Home Care's portal against Helena Cloudpuddle's calendar and aide sign-in sheet so the home-care invoice amount can be used in planning assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal shows more billed aide hours for the first service week than Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet, so the home-care invoice amount is not ready for planning assumptions; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-03.

tickets.title: Prepare affordability figures for care conference
tickets.text: Prepare financial questions and affordability figures for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle ahead of the rehab team's near-term care conference reviewing home therapy authorization and daily supervision.
tickets.evidence: The rehab team set a near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision, and Helena wants financial questions and affordability figures ready for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-08.
